security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: recipe-sync loads the caption and image of one of your own Instagram posts or reels, lets you edit the text, and publishes it as a recipe post on a WordPress site.
